Get 20% off Car Vertical using code Carwow: https://www.carvertical.com/carwow

Mat’s got his hands on a Gunter Werks F-26, and it might be one of his favourite cars he’s reviewed in 2026! 

It’s based on a Porsche 911 993, but the similarities pretty much end at the use of the 993’s steel chassis! So what’s changed? Let’s take a closer look…

In terms of the design, the old steel panels have been removed and replaced with carbon fibre! Up front, there’s a load of carbon aero, including huge vents in the front bumper and a large scoop in the bonnet. Along the side, there are magnesium wheels and wider tyres, and the air intake at the rear wheel arches has been widened. Around the back there’s an absolutely massive wing, and the taillight design has been updated. All in all, it looks absolutely magnificent from the outside.
